sn35.52:1.6: And the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on tongue contact is also contaminated.
sn35.52:1.11: And the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on eye contact is also one they grow disillusioned with …
sn35.52:1.12: They grow disillusioned even with the mind, ideas, mind consciousness, and mind contact.
sn35.52:1.13: And the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact is also one they grow disillusioned with.
sn35.52:1.14: Disillusioned, they become dispassionate; dispassionate, they are released; and when released, there is the knowledge that they are released.
sn35.52:2.7: In the Saḷāyatana-vagga, the first fifty are complete.
